s: December 19, 2025 - The 5-pound bags of lemons at Costco are worth buying — mine usually have a long lifespan, often 2-3 months or more. I store mine in the refrigerator. I use lemons to make my own Caesar salad dressing, marinades, sauces, lemonade, and to garnish my fish. I once counted the lemons in my Costco bag, and I had gotten 20 lemons for $6, so that works out to about 30 cents each.
